harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1 as the authoritative source and node2 to pull /etc/inventory/app.conf every minute. Changes propagated in 21 seconds before restarts and 20 seconds afterward. Both Ubuntu 7.10 nodes retained kernel 2.6.22-14-generic and passed sequential restart/recovery verification.
actions_performed: Initialized the requested file on node1 because it was initially absent.
Created a dedicated unprivileged synchronization account and node-generated RSA credential.
Installed an atomic, overlap-safe rsync script on node2.
Scheduled synchronization through legacy-compatible cron every minute.
Verified real scheduled change propagation before and after sequential node restarts.
Restarted exactly one node at a time and confirmed changed boot identities, recovered services, data, and synchronization.

evidence.requirement: Legacy operating system and kernel preserved
evidence.summary: Both nodes reported Ubuntu 7.10 and kernel 2.6.22-14-generic before and after restart.

evidence.requirement: node1 is authoritative and node2 synchronizes within 15 minutes
evidence.summary: A one-minute cron job invokes the atomic synchronization script. Real changes propagated in 21 seconds before restarts and 20 seconds after restarts, with matching checksums.

evidence.requirement: Credentials generated on managed nodes with restricted access
evidence.summary: node2 generated the task key; node1 restricts it to the dedicated unprivileged account, node2's source address, and disables forwarding and PTY access. Authenticated synchronization succeeded.

Healthy baseline captured; reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed from 62d2c3f6-ceb6-48d9-a9c2-2a3fbcede86d to 66567515-7bee-4e8c-8cfa-f7c8a698f9ca; SSH, cron, authoritative data, and node2 access recovered.

Healthy baseline captured; reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed from 019e21c6-51ae-4747-b8a0-6de5bd4453c1 to e368c7ae-6949-4cb8-b392-fa3552d95718; SSH, cron, synchronized data, credentials, and automatic scheduled synchronization recovered.
